# Supplementary package

Non-core material for EHB 2026. The primary paper is `research/manuscript/main.md`.

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `REPRODUCIBILITY_APPENDIX.md` | Environment, seeds, hashes, commands |
| `../configs/HYPERPARAMETERS.md` | A priori sklearn hyperparameters |
| `../METHODS_FEATURES.md` | Full feature equations |
| `../tables/sensor_ablation_publication.csv` | All 1–4 site combinations |
| `../tables/table5_robustness.csv` | Full perturbation grid |
| `../tables/packet_loss_sweep.csv` | 0–30% simulated loss |
| `../tables/sampling_rate_tradeoff.csv` | Keep-fraction sweep |
| `../tables/feature_ablation.csv` | Peak-only vs full features |
| `../manuscript/SUPPLEMENTARY_ULCER.md` | Why the image CNN is out of the core paper |
| `../STEPMATE_SAFETY.md` | Chat layer must not set risk |
| `../protocols/EHB26_WALKING_PROTOCOL.md` | Future human walking |
| `../protocols/POWER_MEASUREMENT_PROTOCOL.md` | Future battery/BLE power |
| `../figures/fig_reliability_logreg.*` | Reliability diagram |
| `../figures/fig_confidence_hist.*` | Confidence histogram |
| `../figures/fig_error_examples.*` | Error traces |
| `../figures/fig_split_protocols.*` | IID vs grouped |
| `../figures/figS_longitudinal.*` | Simulated longitudinal example (not human) |
| `../figures/figS_ulcer_omitted.*` | Image model omitted |

BLE protocol details: `xstep_ml/protocol.py` and firmware header comments.

Model cards: `models/MODEL_CARD.md`.
